shared_elements: horizontal band of repeated ornament or pattern
justification: The main commonality is generic: both surfaces include profile animals and at least one human or anthropomorphic figure, with a repeated horizontal decorative band. The biggest difference is that B shows an organized procession of human figures interacting with horned quadrupeds, while A is a much more schematic, vertically stacked composition of varied creatures/signs with no comparable human-animal procession.
